text:
Alex: thinking about the permissions matrix in the Console — current layout is huge for enterprise tenants. can we design a compact, scannable view?
Maria: yes. idea: condensed rows per role + an expandable cell for detailed route rules. keep default verbs (view/edit/invoke) visible.
Sam: caution: collapsing hides auditable decisions. we need clear affordances so admins know what changed. audit log entries must map to UI actions.
Dave: +1. also add a search/filter on routes and a ‘templates’ dropdown (read-only, operator, billing, infra). templates make bulk-assign easy.
Julie: enterprise ask: ability to map SAML groups to roles and then show downstream effective permissions. can we show an example "effective permission" tooltip on hover?
Alex: mock: compact grid with row per-role, columns are coarse scopes (Project, Model, Routes), and a little chevron to expand into per-route list. expansion can show a short JSON snippet and last-changed info.
Maria: UX: show a small pill for inherited vs explicit permissions (e.g., "inherited" gray, "explicit" blue). allow inline bulk edit: select multiple routes -> set verb.
Sam: backend implications: need a bulk API path that is idempotent and emits audit events. suggest POST /admin/roles/:id/bulk_edit with payload like:
```json
{"routes": ["/v1/generate","/v1/embeddings"], "verb": "invoke", "scope": "project:abc"}
```
Dave: also need a migration plan for customers with thousands of routes. incremental canary: migrate view-only grouping first, then per-route. provide a dry-run preview that shows the delta.
Julie: quotas interplay: admins expect to tie roles to quota buckets (e.g., low-priority team -> restricted tokens). we should surface which quota applies to a role in the compact view.
Alex: good point. maybe a small quota icon with tooltip linking to quota setting.
Maria: accessibility: keyboard-first nav for the matrix rows and expansion panels. support CSV import/export for roles.
Sam: security: ensure delegation boundaries — only delegated admins can create templates or map SAML groups. also rate-limit bulk edits and log IP.
PolicyBot: FYI: design doc linked https://redwood.internal/docs/perm-compact-v1 (draft) :roll_eyes:
Dave: implementation plan proposal: phase 1: compact matrix UI + search + templates UI + bulk-edit API (beta). phase 2: SAML mapping UI, effective permissions preview, CSV import, quotas badges. phase 3: migration tooling + automatic dry-run canaries.
Alex: decision: we'll prototype phase 1 in the Console next sprint. owners: Alex (frontend), Sam (backend), Maria (UX), Dave (migration lead), Julie (enterprise feedback).
Maria: follow-ups: I'll drop a Figma link in the channel and add acceptance criteria (keyboard nav, audit events, API contract).
Sam: I'll start an API RFC and include audit schema example.
Julie: I'll pull two key enterprise customers for early feedback next week.
Alex: thanks — keeping the UI compact should make permissions manageable for larger orgs without losing traceability. :thumbsup:
